newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures regain ground on gasoline.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures regain ground on gasoline.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures regained lost ground on the back of stronger gasoline, boosted by rumours of difficulties at a refinery, traders said.
December Brent was trading at $24.04 a barrel at 1615 GMT, down three cents but showing a good recovery, having dipped briefly below $23.70 earlier on Thursday afternoon.
"The market is looking more comfortable. It held and now it's going back up," said one IPE floor trader.
November gas oil was down $1.50 a tonne at $224.50, but heading up, having touched a low of $219.50.
Traders said recent heavy selling by U.S. funds was easing and as profits were taken.
"The market was regaining balance, having been bounced down." said a trader.
